description: Bound explicit demo-1 source edits to the repo-local three-way preflight.

hooks.command: sh -c 'd="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != / ]; do if [ -f "$d/config/project-resources.json" ] && [ -f "$d/scripts/awx_device_bus.py" ]; then exec python3 -B "$d/scripts/awx_device_bus.py" hook --root "$d"; fi; d=$(dirname "$d"); done; exit 0'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$d=(Get-Location).ProviderPath; for($i=0;$i -lt 32;$i++){ $p=Join-Path $d 'scripts\awx_device_bus.py'; if((Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d 'config\project-resources.json'))){ & python -B $p hook --root $d; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $n=Split-Path $d -Parent; if(!$n -or $n -eq $d){break}; $d=$n }; exit 0"

hooks.command: sh -c 'd="$PWD"; n=0; i=0; found=""; while [ "$i" -lt 32 ]; do if [ -e "$d/.git" ] && [ -f "$d/AGENTS.md" ] && [ -f "$d/settings.gradle.kts" ] && [ -f "$d/build.gradle.kts" ] && [ -f "$d/.codex/hooks/source_edit_triage.sh" ]; then n=$((n+1)); found="$d/.codex/hooks/source_edit_triage.sh"; fi; [ "$d" = "/" ] && break; d=$(dirname "$d"); i=$((i+1)); done; if [ "$n" -eq 1 ]; then exec sh "$found"; fi; if [ "$n" -gt 1 ]; then echo source-edit-preflight-root-ambiguous >&2; else echo source-edit-preflight-root-unresolved >&2; fi; exit 2'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$dir = (Get-Location).ProviderPath; $roots = [Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new(); for ($remaining = 32; $remaining -gt 0; $remaining--) { $candidate = Join-Path $dir '.codex\hooks\source_edit_triage.ps1'; if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir '.git')) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'AGENTS.md') -PathType Leaf) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'settings.gradle.kts') -PathType Leaf) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'build.gradle.kts') -PathType Leaf) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidate -PathType Leaf)) { [void]$roots.Add($candidate) }; $parent = Split-Path -Path $dir -Parent; if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($parent) -or $parent -eq $dir) { break }; $dir = $parent }; if ($roots.Count -eq 1) { & $roots[0]; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; if ($roots.Count -gt 1) { [Console]::Error.Write('source-edit-preflight-root-ambiguous'); exit 2 }; [Console]::Error.Write('source-edit-preflight-root-unresolved'); exit 2"
